source: Verifier order2 M-c; safe implementation configs and MC1, MC2, pending and scope mutants

invariants.ConnectionRollingMinuteLimit: Committed charged calls per connection with age strictly below two units do not exceed ConnLimit.
invariants.OwnerRollingMinuteLimit: The same rolling set across both connections does not exceed OwnerLimit.
invariants.PendingCapNeverExceeded: Two competing proposals on one connection do not exceed PendingCap.
invariants.ScopeNeverRunsOutsideGrant: An attempted action outside the connection grant never reaches product execution.

abstractions.Call: One committed owner-serialized admission and charged audit append; refused attempts and rolled-back transactions do not add charged calls.
abstractions.Tick: Monotone database time over three discrete points; rows exactly one rolling window old are excluded.
abstractions.CheckCap: The proposal transaction locks the owner before counting live pending rows for one connection.
abstractions.Insert: The same transaction inserts the proposal before releasing its owner lock; chat and approval writes are abstracted.
abstractions.OutsideScope: A not-granted action is refused by delegate policy; the model uses a grant predicate, not individual OAuth scopes.

limits: The scaled owner cap is deliberately below the sum of connection caps so owner and connection invariants are independent; it is not proportional to the production 60/120 ratio.
Each scenario isolates one safety property; this is not a combined rate, pending and scope interleaving proof.
Pending starts one below its cap; approval, expiry and rejection only reduce live pending count and are omitted.

No proof of audit payload privacy, append failure rollback, revoke interleavings, OAuth, database implementation, unbounded time or call volume, fairness, liveness, throughput, retention or indexes is claimed.
